components.name: Draggable
components.description: A list people can reorder by dragging, with the keyboard (Space to lift, arrows to move, Space to drop) or by pointer. Put several inside a `DraggableRoot` with `listId`s to move items between them.

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Called with the reordered list when a move lands in (or leaves) this list.

props.name: listId
props.description: Needed to drag between lists inside one `DraggableRoot`.

props.name: label
props.description: Screen reader name for the list, e.g. "To do".

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description: Screen reader name for an item. Defaults to "item n".

props.name: handle
props.description: Only a `DraggableHandle` inside the item starts a drag.

props.name: accept
props.description: Whether this list takes an item dragged in from another list.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when the list has no items. It still takes drops.

components.name: DraggableHandle
components.description: Grip that starts a drag. Use it inside `renderItem` with `handle` set.

components.name: DraggableRoot
components.description: Lets items move between several `Draggable` lists, e.g. kanban columns. A lone `Draggable` makes its own root, so this is only needed for that.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Fires once per drop that changes something.
